title: Phyn Plus reports a leak event
shortDescription: Pressure-wave analysis flagged a leak signature.
fullDescription: Phyn Plus uses high-rate pressure sensing to detect drip and pinhole leaks. When a sustained low-rate flow with no fixture pattern is seen, the app pushes a leak alert and the auto-shutoff valve closes.

causes.cause: Whole-house humidifier or RO drain false trigger

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Walk the home checking under sinks, behind toilets, washer hoses, water heater drain pan.

fixSteps.title: Restore valve
fixSteps.instruction: If false trigger, tap REOPEN VALVE in app and add the fixture to known patterns.

faq.a: Yes - re-run plumbing assessment from app.

title: Pipe temperature near freezing
fullDescription: Phyn measures water temperature inside the pipe. When it drops below 38F a freeze warning fires. Open faucets to a slow drip and address insulation or ambient temperature.

fixSteps.title: Drip taps
fixSteps.instruction: Open kitchen and farthest faucet to slow drip overnight.

fixSteps.title: Insulate
fixSteps.instruction: Add foam pipe sleeves on exposed runs.

title: Phyn Plus disconnected from cloud
fullDescription: Phyn Plus is 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only. The most common offline cause is a router channel change or band-steering pushing to 5 GHz.

fixSteps.title: Reset Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Press button under cap for 10 sec, re-add via app.

fixSteps.title: Add range extender
fixSteps.instruction: Place a 2.4 GHz extender within 20 feet.

title: Auto-shutoff valve will not open
fullDescription: Phyn Plus integrates a motorized ball valve. After long stationary periods debris or grit may bind the ball. Run the manual TEST cycle weekly to keep it free.

fixSteps.title: Manual override
fixSteps.instruction: Use manual lever to force valve open and contact support.

title: Phyn still in learning mode after a week
shortDescription: Need at least 3 uses per fixture for signature library.
fullDescription: Phyn learns each fixture's pressure signature. Until at least 3 uses per fixture occur, it will keep prompting LEARNING. Use each tap, toilet, and appliance to complete the library.

fixSteps.title: Run fixtures
fixSteps.instruction: Open each tap and flush each toilet 3+ times across a few days.

title: Smart Water Sensor puck low battery
shortDescription: AAA cells in spot leak puck below 20%.
fullDescription: Phyn Smart Water Sensor uses 2x AAA cells. App reports the battery level - replace when below 20%.

fixSteps.title: Replace cells
fixSteps.instruction: Open puck, install 2 fresh AAA alkaline.

title: Spot leak puck wet
fullDescription: When the gold contact pads on the underside of the puck are bridged, an alarm fires. Dry the area and the puck, then check the source.

fixSteps.title: Investigate
fixSteps.instruction: Locate water source - washer, water heater, sink trap.

title: Phyn shows pressure under 20 psi
fullDescription: If house pressure drops below 20 psi the app warns. Common causes are a stuck PRV (pressure reducing valve), a broken supply line, or city work upstream.

fixSteps.title: Check fixtures
fixSteps.instruction: Run tap to confirm low pressure house-wide.

fixSteps.title: Inspect PRV
fixSteps.instruction: Look for water on the PRV body - replace if leaking.

title: Firmware update did not complete
fullDescription: Phyn pulls firmware automatically at 2 AM by default. If Wi-Fi drops mid-update the device retries. If three attempts fail, app shows update failed.

fixSteps.title: Manual update
fixSteps.instruction: From app settings, tap CHECK FOR UPDATES.

title: Plumbing assessment will not complete
fullDescription: The initial assessment requires 4 hours of stable house pressure. Active fixtures (RO drain, ice maker, humidifier) keep the pressure shifting and assessment fails. Run the assessment overnight after pausing those fixtures.

fixSteps.title: Pause appliances
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off ice maker, humidifier, and RO valve overnight.

fixSteps.title: Re-run
fixSteps.instruction: Start assessment from app at bedtime.

faq.a: Once at install, again after major plumbing changes.
